results.question: What is our revenue from repeat customers versus one-time buyers?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_repeat_customer THEN oi.line_total_ex_outliers ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT c.is_repeat_customer THEN oi.line_total_ex_outliers ELSE 0 END) AS one_time_revenue
FROM 
    gold.dim_customers c
JOIN 
    gold.fct_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    gold.fct_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 
    c.segment

results.question: What is our checkout conversion rate?
results.sql:
WITH checkout_events AS (
  SELECT event_id, customer_id, event_ts
  FROM silver.stg_events
  WHERE event_type = 'checkout_start'
),
valid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM gold.fct_orders
  WHERE is_completed
),
valid_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM gold.dim_customers
  WHERE total_orders > 0
),
valid_checkout_events AS (
  SELECT ce.event_id, ce.customer_id, ce.event_ts
  FROM checkout_events ce
  JOIN valid_orders vo ON ce.order_id = vo.order_id
  JOIN valid_customers vc ON ce.customer_id = vc.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_id) AS checkout_count
FROM valid_checkout_events ce
JOIN gold.fct_orders fo ON ce.order_id = fo.order_id
JOIN gold.dim_customers dc ON ce.customer_id = dc.customer_id
WHERE fo.is_completed
